3-Ingredient Vegan Brownies

  • ¾ cup brewed coffee
  • 1-15 oz can of black beans, drained & rinsed (keep the aquafaba for baking!)
  • 1 package brownie mix
  • 1 cup chocolate chips, divided (optional)
  • To begin making your 3-ingredient vegan brownies, brew a cup of coffee.
  • Preheat oven according to package instructions (Usually 350F) and lightly grease a 9x13-in baking dish.
  • In a high-speed blender, blend 1 can of drained black beans and ¾ cup of brewed coffee until smooth.
  • Open a boxed brownie mix and pour into a large mixing bowl.
  • Pour the coffee/bean mixture into the bowl with the brownie mix and stir until you get a smooth batter. Optional: fold in ½ cup of chocolate chips.
  • Pour vegan brownie batter into the prepared baking dish and sprinkle with ½ cup chocolate chips, optional.
  • Bake brownies according to package directions (about 25 mins), until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
  • Cool on a wire cooling rack, cut into squares and serve.
